Open is directly attested as a file-dialog/button command. The glossary uses the same verb for generic Load and Insert, so a mechanical choice would obscure this distinction. This is contextual translation, not an unannounced correction to English.
rows.behavior: The File menu passes import=false into launchOpen after confirmation. ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT falls back to GET_CONTENT; replacement occurs only after a successful result, optional frame/page/size selection and decode. import=true follows the distinct paste path. Picker or intermediate dialog cancellation may leave the existing document in place. Temporary cache-file cleanup is not deletion of the selected saved original.
rows.punctuation: Keep U+2026: the picker and sometimes further choices intervene.

rows.behavior: The neutral button calls the requested continuation without first saving. The button is not an immediate bitmap-erasure operation, a saved-file deletion command, an Undo/revert command, or a guarantee that recovery drafts are destroyed.
